va-05:2018.note: Localities wholly inside VA-05 under both the 2016 court-ordered map (2018) and the 2021 Supreme Court of Virginia map (2024, 2026). Split localities (Bedford County, Henry County, Fauquier County, Albemarle County, Hanover County) are excluded because locality-level totals include precincts from other districts.
